prep_notes: Pre-portion nachos, chips and tortillas before the rush window

agentic_insight.note: Scheduled to run at the end of the day on Oct 6 (21:30); this is the forecast it will start from.
agentic_insight.summary: Statistical prediction for a Tuesday is 137 items [1]. The agent forecasts 165 (+20%), a lift of about 28 items from one hotspot event. Tavily confirms the Warriors host the Lakers at Chase Center, 19:00, 0.9 mi from the truck [2], and lists it as the marquee game of the home preseason [3]. Mem0 recalls the closest past nights at the same arena, the Valkyries on <<2026-09-18|Sep 18>> and <<2026-10-02|Oct 2>>: only +14% and +11% over trend, with the extra sales landing 17:00 to 18:00 [4]. Why the agent goes above those Valkyries nights: a Warriors game seats up to 18,064 and the Lakers draw a fuller house, so it scales the lift to +20%. Why not higher: preseason, a Tuesday, and a 19:00 tip-off means most fans reach Chase Center between 17:00 and 18:30. It also discounts the Wednesday concert surges on <<2026-09-09|Sep 9>> and <<2026-09-23|Sep 23>>, which were really Giants day games [5]. Nothing else is in play: dry weather and no closures [6]. Expect the peak around 18:00 rather than the usual lunch rush.

sources.query:
SELECT day_of_week,
       ROUND(AVG(baseline_items), 1) AS baseline_items,
       COUNT(*)                      AS n_days
FROM   daily_trend
WHERE  day_of_week = 'Tuesday'
  AND  date < '2026-10-06'
GROUP  BY day_of_week;
sources.note: daily_trend rolls the sales table up per day; baseline_items is the no-event trend for that weekday.
